description: This file contains functions and scripts for configuring Wi-Fi access points, including WPA/WPA2/WPA3 security, WPS, VLAN, and other network settings, primarily for hostapd and wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_rate
methods.description: Adds a rate value to a variable, converting from Kbps to Mbps and formatting.

methods.name: hostapd_add_rate
methods.description: Adds a rate value in Mbps to a variable.

methods.name: hostapd_append_wep_key
methods.description: Appends WEP keys to configuration based on key index.

methods.name: hostapd_append_wpa_key_mgmt
methods.description: Determines WPA key management protocols based on auth_type and security features.

methods.name: hostapd_common_add_device_config
methods.description: Adds common device configuration parameters for hostapd.

methods.name: hostapd_prepare_device_config
methods.description: Prepares device-specific hostapd configuration based on parameters and defaults.

methods.name: hostapd_set_bss_options
methods.description: Sets BSS (Basic Service Set) specific options for hostapd, including security, VLAN, and other network parameters.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_teardown_interface
methods.description: Removes configuration and state files for a wpa_supplicant interface.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_prepare_interface
methods.description: Prepares wpa_supplicant configuration for a specific interface, including mode and frequency settings.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_set_fixed_freq
methods.description: Sets fixed frequency and channel width options for a wpa_supplicant network.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_network
methods.description: Adds a network configuration to wpa_supplicant with security and network parameters.
